Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterprets the correct IMDb release date of 2019-02-28 as 1991-02-28 by incorrectly combining the film's title year with the metadata date. This fabrication of a false release date creates an irreversible error that directly leads to the wrong final conclusion that Dilan 1991 came out first.
